name: Not Cheating, Improving My Lie
title: Men's Golf – Not Cheating, Improving My Lie Boxer Briefs
story: Not cheating, improving my lie: funny boxer briefs for the golfer who has nudged a ball out of the rough with his foot and swears it rolled there, a gift for the man who plays every Saturday, wrapped for Christmas or Father's Day.

The print is a smug raccoon in an argyle vest and flat cap, club tucked under one arm, sliding his ball to a better spot in the tall grass, repeated over the whole pair on navy with NOT CHEATING. IMPROVING MY LIE. set once in cream and gold capitals across the back. The art matches our Not Cheating, Improving My Lie hoodie, so the golf layer and the funny boxer briefs can be a set.

Lie is the golfer's word for where the ball ended up, which keeps the joke clean on underwear and sharp on the course: every golfer has seen the foot wedge and nobody admits to it. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order, an easy stocking stuffer for a man who already owns every tee and ball marker.
joke_a: In golf, your lie is where the ball sits, and improving it with a foot is cheating everyone has seen and nobody admits. The Not Cheating, Improving My Lie Boxer Briefs from Graphic Tees Co. put a smug raccoon on the offense, so the joke reads on the course and in the drawer.
ink: the navy, cream and gold print
source: Not Cheating, Improving My Lie hoodie
